card.name: Word after a modifier, before a noun
card.fires_on: The word right after a modifier such as business, oral, rectal, transmucosal or hand, where it names a user, dosage form or route. It fires on that word itself, not on the later noun it feeds.

modes.description: The form word after oral, film-coated or a route stem, such as powder or solution.

modes.description: The ending of a route adverb or adjective like transmucosal or rectally.

modes.description: A person or tool word that forms a compound, such as end-user or hand ball test.
